question: Should ambient `$CODEX_HOME` sessions appear as a separate ledger beside the selected managed-account ledger, or intentionally replace account-scoped cost history?
rationale: Both data sources are valid but can represent different users or organizations; source inspection cannot decide which identity and aggregation model the product should promise.

options.title: Keep Both Scopes
options.body: Preserve managed-account cost history and expose ambient local sessions separately or merge them with explicit source labels and deduplication.

options.title: Replace Account Scope
options.body: Approve ambient sessions as the sole local ledger, with explicit upgrade disclosure and tests proving how managed-account users are affected.

options.title: Pause The Feature
options.body: Defer the ledger until its account identity, setting ownership, and mixed-source reconciliation contract are defined.

recommendation.title: Keep Both Scopes
recommendation.body: Preserve managed-account cost history and expose ambient local sessions separately or merge them with explicit source labels and deduplication.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior work introduced the account-aware cost-history behavior whose product contract this PR changes.
